messages:
Carmen (Sales): Nimbus wants a joint co-sell pilot: Redwood Private reachable via VPC peering, SAML SSO, static egress IPs, 90d audit logs, 6-week trial. Need pilot pricing and tech blockers.

Alex P (Eng): Need traffic profile and max seq length. That dictates GPU sizing and KV cache.

Carmen (Sales): They said ~25 rps steady, spikes to 90 for short demos, avg <=350 tokens.

Samir (Platform): For that, 2x A10 equiv + autoscale should work. We need partner AWS account id, peering CIDR, and whether they accept hosted control plane.

Leah T (Partnerships): Nimbus prefers our control plane hosted with VPC peering.

Nora (Security): I'll run their questionnaire. If BYOK requested, need KMS ARN and cross-account policy — adds ~3 days. I can provide SOC2 and log-retention export scripts.

Carmen (Sales): Proposed pilot price: $5k flat + capped usage. Post-pilot convert to committed Dedicated.

Samir (Platform): I'll draft a pilot runbook + acceptance criteria and publish egress IPs. Creating ticket now.

InfraBot: Ticket RWF-4895 created and assigned to @Samir. ETA 48h.

Leah T (Partnerships): Sending network form and SAML sample; scheduling tech sync Thu 10am PT.

Alex P (Eng): Sample SP metadata and provisioning snippet will go into runbook. Also suggest headers `X-Redwood-Partner` and `X-Redwood-Tenant` for tracing.

Carmen (Sales): Nora please prioritize questionnaire answers. Leah, loop Legal for a short SOW.

Nora (Security): On it — aim to return answers tomorrow EOD.

Samir (Platform): Will post runbook draft in 36h and cost estimate for a 3-node commitment.

Carmen (Sales): Thanks team — will update Nimbus after runbook draft.
